text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... So far... They're 
still... way too far ahead...
choice_data_list:
Ryan, was the distance a little long for 
you?
Ryan, was the distance too long?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, what's far is the distance between me 
and McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even though I thought I closed the gap, I 
couldn't reach her at all...

Mejiro McQueen was indeed strong. 
Especially at her specialty distance of 
3000m.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems you managed to uphold your pride. 
Well done, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen... I lost. As expected, at this 
distance, her stamina and grit are just on 
another level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is true. Long-distance races, 
the very thing I have kept my eyes fixed 
upon since childhood...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I cannot simply step aside. The time I 
have poured into this is entirely 
different, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All the time I've poured into this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Trainer, maybe losing wasn't 
because of distance aptitude after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The distance was a big factor, but what 
was even bigger was the number of years...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen has always aimed to win. I've only 
just begun aiming for it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That difference in years is what caused 
the difference today. Surely...

Mejiro McQueen. She is, perhaps, a stayer 
through life itself.

"Compared to that, Mejiro Ryan's 
inexperience is undeniable."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to stability, I do seem to 
hold the advantage. However, next time at 
least—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I wish to see a moment of true tenacity 
from you. A dazzling, breathtaking burst 
of energy in the final furlong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That dynamic surge in the final furlong...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Understood, McQueen! I promise! Next time 
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, speaking of big races coming up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen! You'll race against me 
again at the Arima Kinen, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, now, I cannot make any promises.

Though she couldn't defeat Mejiro McQueen, 
there is no longer any sense of 
inferiority in Mejiro Ryan's eyes.

And the road stretches even further. To 
the end-of-year "Arima Kinen," where 
formidable, unknown rivals await.
